entries.example_en: Don't give up learning English—it takes time.
entries.example_zh: 不要放弃学英语——这需要时间。

entries.example_en: Can you look after my cat while I'm on holiday?
entries.example_zh: 我度假时你能帮我照看一下猫吗？

entries.example_en: Please turn on the lights; it's getting dark.
entries.example_zh: 请打开灯，天快黑了。

entries.example_en: They put off the meeting until next Monday.
entries.example_zh: 他们把会议推迟到了下周一。

entries.example_en: She came up with a great idea for the project.
entries.example_zh: 她为这个项目想出了一个妙主意。

entries.example_en: We've run out of milk, so I'll buy some more.
entries.example_zh: 牛奶用完了，所以我再去买一些。

entries.example_en: I'm looking forward to seeing you next week.
entries.example_zh: 我盼着下周见到你。

entries.example_en: He gets along well with his classmates.
entries.example_zh: 他和同学们相处得很好。

entries.example_en: The scientists carried out several experiments last month.
entries.example_zh: 科学家们上个月进行了几项实验。

entries.example_en: I can't put up with the noise any longer.
entries.example_zh: 我再也忍受不了这种噪音了。

entries.example_en: Please take off your shoes before you enter the room.
entries.example_zh: 进屋前请把鞋脱掉。

entries.meaning_zh: 查明，弄清楚（事实、真相等）
entries.example_en: I want to find out what time the museum opens.
entries.example_zh: 我想查明博物馆几点开门。

entries.example_en: Remember to turn off the lights before you leave the classroom.
entries.example_zh: 离开教室前记得关灯。

entries.example_en: She picked up the book from the floor and put it on the desk.
entries.example_zh: 她把书从地板上捡起来放到桌上。

entries.example_en: He put on his coat and went out into the snow.
entries.example_zh: 他穿上外套，走进雪中。

entries.example_en: What do you want to be when you grow up?
entries.example_zh: 你长大后想做什么？

entries.example_en: Please give back the pen you borrowed from me yesterday.
entries.example_zh: 请把你昨天借我的笔还给我。

entries.example_en: If you don't know the word, look it up in the dictionary.
entries.example_zh: 如果你不认识这个单词，就在词典里查一查。

entries.example_en: Our bus broke down on the way to school this morning.
entries.example_zh: 今天早上我们的校车在上学路上抛锚了。

entries.example_en: I came across an old friend in the supermarket yesterday.
entries.example_zh: 我昨天在超市偶然遇到一位老朋友。

entries.example_en: I usually get up at half past six on school days.
entries.example_zh: 我上学日通常六点半起床。

entries.example_en: Please put away your toys before dinner.
entries.example_zh: 晚饭前请把玩具收好。

entries.example_en: Look out! The floor is wet.
entries.example_zh: 小心！地板是湿的。

entries.example_en: She will come back from Beijing next Monday.
entries.example_zh: 她下周一从北京回来。

entries.example_en: He didn't turn up at the party until nine o'clock.
entries.example_zh: 他直到九点才在聚会上露面。

entries.example_en: They set up a new club for students who love science.
entries.example_zh: 他们为热爱科学的学生成立了一个新社团。

entries.example_en: Tom takes after his father in both looks and character.
entries.example_zh: 汤姆的长相和性格都像他爸爸。

entries.example_en: She was brought up by her grandparents in the countryside.
entries.example_zh: 她由乡下的祖父母抚养长大。

entries.meaning_zh: 克服；从（疾病、不快）中恢复
entries.example_en: It took him weeks to get over the bad cold.
entries.example_zh: 他花了好几周才从重感冒中恢复过来。

entries.example_en: The football match was called off because of the heavy rain.
entries.example_zh: 由于大雨，足球赛被取消了。

entries.example_en: I lost my key somewhere in the park, so I have to go back and look for it.
entries.example_zh: 我把钥匙丢在公园的某个地方了，所以我得回去找一找。

entries.example_en: She tried on three dresses before choosing the blue one.
entries.example_zh: 她试穿了三条裙子才选中那条蓝色的。

entries.example_en: Hurry up! The bus is leaving, and we need to get on right now.
entries.example_zh: 快点！公交车要开了，我们得马上上车。

entries.example_en: Please hand in your homework before Friday.
entries.example_zh: 请在周五前上交你的作业。

entries.example_en: He turned down the job offer because the salary was too low.
entries.example_zh: 他拒绝了那份工作邀请，因为薪水太低。

entries.example_en: We set off early in the morning to avoid the heavy traffic.
entries.example_zh: 我们一大早就出发，以避开拥堵的交通。

entries.example_en: It took her an hour to work out the answer to the maths problem.
entries.example_zh: 她花了一个小时才解出那道数学题的答案。

entries.example_en: He walks so fast that I can't keep up with him.
entries.example_zh: 他走得太快了，我跟不上他。

entries.example_en: I ran into an old friend at the supermarket yesterday.
entries.example_zh: 我昨天在超市偶遇了一位老朋友。

entries.example_en: We need to sort out this mess before Mum gets home.
entries.example_zh: 我们得在妈妈回家前把这一团糟整理好。

entries.example_en: The meeting must go on as planned, even though the manager is ill.
entries.example_zh: 尽管经理生病了，会议仍必须按计划继续进行。

entries.example_en: Hold on a moment, please—I'll get a pen.
entries.example_zh: 请稍等一下，我去拿支笔。

entries.example_en: We like to hang out at the shopping centre on weekends.
entries.example_zh: 我们周末喜欢在购物中心闲逛。

entries.example_en: Her new novel will come out next month.
entries.example_zh: 她的新小说下个月出版。

entries.example_en: I can't figure out how to solve this math problem.
entries.example_zh: 我弄不明白这道数学题怎么解。

entries.example_en: The teacher pointed out two mistakes in my essay.
entries.example_zh: 老师指出了我文章中的两处错误。

entries.example_en: He decided to take up photography as a hobby.
entries.example_zh: 他决定开始把摄影当作一种爱好。

entries.example_en: I promised to help her, and I won't let her down.
entries.example_zh: 我答应过要帮她，我不会让她失望的。

entries.example_en: My alarm goes off at six every morning.
entries.example_zh: 我的闹钟每天早上六点响起。

entries.example_en: He was ill for a week and fell behind with his schoolwork.
entries.example_zh: 他病了一周，功课落后了。

entries.example_en: I usually wake up at six o'clock and get out of bed.
entries.example_zh: 我通常六点醒来就起床。

entries.example_en: Please write down your name and phone number on this form.
entries.example_zh: 请在这张表格上写下你的姓名和电话号码。

entries.example_en: Don't throw away those old clothes; we can give them to the poor.
entries.example_zh: 别扔掉那些旧衣服，我们可以捐给穷人。

entries.example_en: We tried to cheer him up after he failed the exam.
entries.example_zh: 他考试失利后，我们设法让他高兴起来。

entries.example_en: Lucy wants to try out for the school play this year.
entries.example_zh: 露西想参加今年校园话剧的选拔。

entries.example_en: He made up an excuse because he didn't want to go to the party.
entries.example_zh: 他编了个借口，因为不想去参加聚会。

entries.example_en: Her son will take over the family business when she retires.
entries.example_zh: 她退休后，儿子将接管家族企业。

entries.example_en: You shouldn't look down on people who are poorer than you.
entries.example_zh: 你不应该看不起比你穷的人。

entries.meaning_zh: 经历（困难时期）；仔细查看
entries.example_en: The company is going through a hard time because of low sales.
entries.example_zh: 由于销量低迷，公司正经历一段艰难时期。

entries.example_en: He dropped out of school at sixteen to help his family.
entries.example_zh: 他十六岁时辍学帮家里干活。

entries.example_en: He ended up working in a bank after trying several jobs.
entries.example_zh: 尝试了几份工作后，他最终在一家银行工作。

entries.example_en: Get off the bus at the next stop.
entries.example_zh: 在下一站下车。

entries.example_en: Don't stay up too late before the exam.
entries.example_zh: 考试前不要熬夜太晚。

entries.example_en: The small town has turned into a busy city.
entries.example_zh: 这个小镇已经变成了一座繁忙的城市。

entries.example_en: She ran fast to catch up with her friends.
entries.example_zh: 她跑得很快去赶上她的朋友们。

entries.example_en: I have a lot of homework to deal with tonight.
entries.example_zh: 今晚我有很多作业要处理。

entries.example_en: Young players often look up to famous athletes.
entries.example_zh: 年轻球员常常钦佩著名运动员。

entries.example_en: The teacher gave out the exam papers to the students.
entries.example_zh: 老师把试卷分发给学生。

entries.example_en: The school will look into the matter carefully.
entries.example_zh: 学校会认真调查这件事。

entries.example_en: You can count on me to help you move house.
entries.example_zh: 你可以指望我帮你搬家。

entries.example_en: She gave away all her old clothes to the charity.
entries.example_zh: 她把所有的旧衣服都送给了慈善机构。

entries.example_en: The dog ran away when the gate was left open.
entries.example_zh: 门开着的时候，那只狗跑掉了。

entries.example_en: Let's put up a tent by the lake tonight.
entries.example_zh: 今晚我们在湖边搭个帐篷吧。

entries.example_en: Let's go over the answers before you hand in your paper.
entries.example_zh: 交卷之前，我们先把答案检查一遍吧。

entries.example_en: I'm sorry — I take back what I said about you.
entries.example_zh: 对不起，我收回我说的关于你的话。

entries.example_en: He promised to pay back the money by the end of the month.
entries.example_zh: 他承诺月底前把钱还清。

entries.example_en: The letters 'BBC' stand for the British Broadcasting Corporation.
entries.example_zh: 字母 BBC 代表英国广播公司。

entries.meaning_zh: （在旅馆、机场等）登记；办理手续
entries.example_en: We checked in at the hotel and then went straight to the pool.
entries.example_zh: 我们在旅馆办理了入住手续，然后直接去了游泳池。

entries.example_en: He drives too fast just to show off his new car.
entries.example_zh: 他开车太快，只是为了炫耀他的新车。

entries.example_en: Children wear out their shoes very quickly.
entries.example_zh: 孩子们很快就会把鞋穿破。

entries.example_en: Take a deep breath and calm down; there's no need to shout.
entries.example_zh: 深呼吸，冷静下来，没必要大喊大叫。

entries.example_en: The teacher will hand out the exam papers in a minute.
entries.example_zh: 老师马上会分发试卷。

entries.example_en: Please fill in your name and phone number at the top of the form.
entries.example_zh: 请在表格顶部填写你的姓名和电话号码。

entries.example_en: A strange question came up during the interview.
entries.example_zh: 面试中出现了一个奇怪的问题。

entries.example_en: We had to go back home because I forgot my keys.
entries.example_zh: 我们不得不回家，因为我忘带钥匙了。

entries.example_en: This old song brings back memories of my childhood.
entries.example_zh: 这首老歌让我回想起童年。

entries.example_en: Carry on with your work while I answer the phone.
entries.example_zh: 我接电话时，你们继续工作。

entries.example_en: The doctor told him to cut down on sugar and salt.
entries.example_zh: 医生告诉他要减少糖和盐的摄入。

entries.example_en: Don't leave out any details when you write the report.
entries.example_zh: 写报告时不要遗漏任何细节。

entries.example_en: The party turned out to be a great success.
entries.example_zh: 这次聚会结果非常成功。

entries.example_en: She took out her keys and opened the front door.
entries.example_zh: 她拿出钥匙打开了前门。

entries.meaning_zh: 进来；（款式、时尚）开始流行
entries.example_en: Please knock before you come in.
entries.example_zh: 进来之前请先敲门。

entries.example_en: The candle went out when the wind blew through the window.
entries.example_zh: 风从窗户吹进来时，蜡烛熄灭了。

entries.example_en: Put down your pens when the exam ends.
entries.example_zh: 考试结束时请放下笔。

entries.example_en: We went to the station to see off our uncle.
entries.example_zh: 我们去车站为叔叔送行。

entries.example_en: Please think over my offer and call me tomorrow.
entries.example_zh: 请仔细考虑我的提议，明天给我打电话。

entries.example_en: Mom finally gave in and bought me the new bike.
entries.example_zh: 妈妈终于让步，给我买了那辆新自行车。

entries.example_en: Only ten people showed up at the club meeting last night.
entries.example_zh: 昨晚只有十个人出席了俱乐部会议。

entries.example_en: His bright yellow jacket made him stand out in the crowd.
entries.example_zh: 他亮黄色的夹克使他在人群中很显眼。

entries.example_en: I called several times but couldn't get through to the office.
entries.example_zh: 我打了几次电话，但都没能接通办公室。

questions.stem: The math problem was hard, but Li Lei didn't ____ and finally solved it.
questions.explain: 句意是「没有放弃」，give up 意为放弃，其余选项分别是推迟、用完、执行，不符合语境。

questions.stem: What does "look after" mean?
questions.explain: look after 表示照顾、照料某人或某物，如 look after a baby（照顾婴儿）。

questions.stem: It's getting dark. Please ____ the lights.
questions.explain: 天黑了要「打开」灯，turn on 表示打开电器；其余选项意思都不合适。

questions.stem: What does "put off" mean?
questions.explain: put off 表示把活动、会议等推迟、延期，如 put off the meeting（推迟会议）。

questions.stem: Tom ____ a clever plan to raise money for the school library.
questions.explain: 「想出」一个计划要用 come up with，此处用过去式 came up with。

questions.stem: What does "run out of" mean?
questions.explain: run out of 表示某物用完了、耗尽了，如 run out of time（时间用完了）。

questions.stem: The students are ____ visiting the museum next Friday.
questions.explain: 学生们「盼望」参观博物馆，look forward to 后接动词-ing 形式。

questions.stem: What does "get along with" mean?
questions.explain: get along with 表示与某人相处融洽，如 get along well with classmates（和同学相处很好）。

questions.stem: The company asked the team to ____ the plan as soon as possible.
questions.explain: 「执行、实施」计划用 carry out；come up with 意为想出，与 plan 搭配虽常见但此处表示已制定好的计划要被执行。

questions.stem: What does "put up with" mean?
questions.explain: put up with 表示忍受、容忍不愉快的事情，如 can't put up with the noise（无法忍受噪音）。

questions.stem: It's hot in the room. Please ____ your coat before you sit down.
questions.explain: 屋里很热，应该"脱掉"外套，take off 表示脱下衣物。

questions.stem: What does "find out" mean?
options: C. 查明，弄清楚（事实、真相等）
questions.explain: find out 意为查明、弄清楚（事实、真相等）。

questions.stem: Don't waste electricity. Please ____ the lights when you leave the classroom.
questions.explain: 离开教室要节约用电，应"关掉"灯，故选 turn off。

questions.stem: What does "pick up" mean?
questions.explain: pick up 意为捡起，也可表示接某人。

questions.stem: It's cold outside, so ____ your warm jacket before going out.
questions.explain: 外面很冷，出门前应"穿上"暖和的夹克，故选 put on。

questions.stem: What does "grow up" mean?
options: C. 偶然遇见；偶然发现
questions.explain: grow up 意为长大、成长。

questions.stem: You can borrow my dictionary, but remember to ____ it to me tomorrow.
questions.explain: 借的东西明天要"归还"，give back 表示归还。

questions.stem: What does "look up" mean?
options: D. 偶然遇见；偶然发现
questions.explain: look up 意为查阅（单词、信息等）。

questions.stem: Our car ____ on the highway, so we had to call for help.
questions.explain: 车在高速公路上"抛锚"了所以要求助，broke down 表示（车辆）出故障。

questions.stem: What does "come across" mean?
options: C. 偶然遇见；偶然发现
questions.explain: come across 意为偶然遇见或偶然发现。

questions.stem: I ____ at six every morning and then do some exercise.
questions.explain: get up 意为“起床”，符合早上锻炼的日常作息语境。

questions.stem: What does 'put away' mean?
questions.explain: put away 指把东西收拾好、放回原处。

questions.stem: ____! There's a car coming.
questions.explain: look out 意为“小心、当心”，用于提醒危险。

questions.stem: What does 'come back' mean?
questions.explain: come back 意为“回来、返回某地”。

questions.stem: He promised to come to the party, but he didn't ____ until nine o'clock.
questions.explain: turn up 意为“出现、露面”，指人或事物到场、出现。

questions.stem: What does 'set up' mean?
questions.explain: set up 意为“建立、设立”，如成立社团、公司等。

questions.stem: Everyone says Lily ____ her mother—they both have big eyes and a warm smile.
questions.explain: take after 意为“（长相或性格）像某位长辈”。

questions.stem: What does 'bring up' mean?
options: D. 抚养长大；提出（话题）
questions.explain: bring up 既可表示“抚养长大”，也可表示“提出话题”。

questions.stem: It took her a long time to ____ the flu, but now she feels much better.
questions.explain: get over 意为“从疾病（或不快）中恢复过来”。

questions.stem: What does 'call off' mean?
questions.explain: call off 意为“取消、终止”已安排好的活动。

questions.stem: I lost my key somewhere in the park, so we should go back and ____ it.
questions.explain: look for 表示"寻找"，强调寻找的过程，句意是"回去找钥匙"。

questions.stem: What does "try on" mean?
questions.explain: try on 意为"试穿"，常用于试穿衣服、鞋子等。

questions.stem: Hurry up! The train is about to leave. Let's ____ quickly.
questions.explain: get on 表示"上车、上船、上火车"，句意是"火车要开了，我们赶紧上车"。

questions.stem: Which is the correct meaning of "hand in"?
questions.explain: hand in 意为"上交、提交"，常用于交作业或交文件。

questions.stem: She ____ the invitation to the party because she had to study for the exam.
questions.explain: turn down 表示"拒绝（邀请、提议等）"，句意是"她因为要复习而拒绝了邀请"。

questions.stem: In the sentence "They set off at dawn", what does "set off" mean?
questions.explain: set off 意为"出发、启程"，句意是"他们在黎明时分出发"。

questions.stem: Don't worry—everything will ____ fine in the end.
questions.explain: work out 可表示"（情况）得到解决、结果良好"，句意是"别担心，最终一切都会顺利"。

questions.stem: What does "keep up with" mean?
questions.explain: keep up with 意为"跟上、不落后于"，指保持与他人同样的速度或水平。

questions.stem: I ____ my primary school teacher at the airport last week—it was a big surprise!
questions.explain: run into 表示"偶然遇见"，强调意外地碰见某人。

questions.stem: Which is the correct meaning of "sort out"?
questions.explain: sort out 意为"整理、解决"，指把杂乱的东西收拾好或把问题处理好。

questions.stem: The meeting must ____ as planned, even though the manager is ill.
questions.explain: 句意是会议必须继续进行，所以用 go on 表示"继续"。

questions.stem: Choose the correct Chinese meaning of "hold on".
questions.explain: hold on 常用于电话或口语中，表示"稍等一下"。

questions.stem: Teenagers often ____ at the shopping centre after school.
questions.explain: 青少年放学后常在购物中心"闲逛"，所以选 hang out。

questions.stem: Choose the correct Chinese meaning of "come out".
questions.explain: come out 用于书籍、电影等时表示"出版、发行"。

questions.stem: It took me an hour to ____ how to open the locked box.
questions.explain: figure out 表示经过思考"弄清楚、想出"办法。

questions.stem: Choose the correct Chinese meaning of "point out".
questions.explain: point out 意为"指出"错误、问题等。

questions.stem: My sister wants to ____ a new hobby, like painting or tennis.
questions.explain: 开始一项新的爱好要用 take up。

questions.stem: Choose the correct Chinese meaning of "let down".
questions.explain: let sb down 意为"让某人失望"。

questions.stem: I was still asleep when my alarm ____ at seven.
questions.explain: 闹钟"响起"用 go off，注意时态为过去式 went off。

questions.stem: Choose the correct Chinese meaning of "fall behind".
questions.explain: fall behind 表示进度上"落后、跟不上"。

questions.stem: It's already seven o'clock! Time to ____ and have breakfast.
questions.explain: wake up 意为「醒来」，符合早晨起床吃早餐的语境。

questions.stem: What does "write down" mean?
questions.explain: write down 表示「写下、记下」，如把电话号码记在纸上。

questions.stem: Don't ____ those old magazines; we can recycle them instead.
questions.explain: throw away 意为「扔掉」，与后文「回收利用」形成合理语境。

questions.stem: What does "cheer up" mean?
options: B. 使高兴起来；振作起来
questions.explain: cheer up 指「使某人高兴起来、振作起来」，常用于安慰他人。

questions.stem: Lucy wants to ____ for the school basketball team this term.
questions.explain: try out for 表示「参加……的选拔」，后接球队、社团等。

questions.stem: What does "make up" mean in "He made up an excuse"?
options: C. 编造（故事、借口）；和好
questions.explain: make up + excuse/story 表示「编造借口、编故事」。

questions.stem: Her son will ____ the family business when she retires next year.
questions.explain: take over 意为「接管、接任」，符合接手企业的语境。

questions.stem: What does "look down on" mean?
questions.explain: look down on 表示「看不起、轻视」，是不礼貌的态度。

questions.stem: The family is ____ a difficult time after losing their home in the fire.
questions.explain: go through 表示「经历（困难时期）」，符合失去家园的语境。

questions.stem: What does "drop out" mean?
questions.explain: drop out 表示「辍学、中途退出」，常与 of school 搭配。

questions.stem: If you keep practising English every day, you will ____ speaking it fluently.
questions.explain: end up doing sth 表示“最终做某事、以某种结果告终”，其余选项词义与句意不符。

questions.stem: What does 'get off' mean in "Don't get off the bus until it stops"?
questions.explain: get off 指“下车、下船等”，这里指公交车停稳前不要下车。

questions.stem: Tom ____ late last night to finish his science project.
questions.explain: stay up late 表示“熬夜到很晚”，符合为完成项目而晚睡的语境。

questions.stem: What does 'turn into' mean in "Water can turn into ice in winter"?
questions.explain: turn into 表示“变成”，指水在冬天会变成冰。

questions.stem: After two weeks of illness, Liu Ming studied hard to ____ his classmates.
questions.explain: catch up with sb 表示“赶上某人”，指生病落下功课 后努力赶上同学。

questions.stem: What does 'deal with' mean in "She knows how to deal with difficult problems"?
questions.explain: deal with 表示“处理、应付”，指她懂得如何解决难题。

questions.stem: Most students in our class ____ Mr. Wang because he is patient and helpful.
questions.explain: look up to sb 表示“钦佩、尊敬某人”，与“他耐心又乐于助人”的原因相符。

questions.stem: What does 'give out' mean in "A volunteer gave out maps to the tourists"?
questions.explain: give out 表示“分发”，指志愿者把地图分发给游客。

questions.stem: The police promised to ____ the case as soon as possible.
questions.explain: look into 表示“调查”，指警方承诺尽快调查这起案件。

questions.stem: What does 'count on' mean in "We can count on Tom to keep the secret"?
questions.explain: count on sb to do sth 表示“指望某人做某事”，指我们可以指望汤姆保守秘密。

questions.stem: Lily decided to ____ her old storybooks to the village school.
questions.explain: give away 意为“赠送；送掉”，句意为她把旧故事书送给乡村学校。

questions.stem: Which is the correct meaning of the phrase 'run away'?
questions.explain: run away 意为“逃跑；逃走”。

questions.stem: The students helped ____ some posters on the wall before the art show.
questions.explain: put up 意为“张贴”，句意为学生们帮忙在墙上贴海报。

questions.stem: What does the phrase 'go over' mean?
questions.explain: go over 意为“复习；仔细检查”。

questions.stem: I didn't mean to hurt you — I'd like to ____ what I said just now.
questions.explain: take back 意为“收回（说过的话）”，句意是我想收回刚才说的话。

questions.stem: Which is the correct meaning of the phrase 'pay back'?
questions.explain: pay back 意为“偿还；还钱给（某人）”。

questions.stem: The letters 'PTA' ____ 'Parent-Teacher Association'.
questions.explain: stand for 意为“代表；象征”，句意为 PTA 代表家长教师协会。

questions.stem: What does the phrase 'check in' mean?
options: B. （在旅馆、机场等）登记；办理手续
questions.explain: check in 意为“（在旅馆、机场等）登记；办理手续”。

questions.stem: Mike keeps telling everyone about his gold medal — he loves to ____.
questions.explain: show off 意为“炫耀；卖弄”，句意是迈克喜欢炫耀他的金牌。

questions.stem: What does the phrase 'wear out' mean?
options: B. 穿破；用坏；（使）筋疲力尽
questions.explain: wear out 意为“穿破；用坏”，也可指“（使）筋疲力尽”。

questions.stem: The teacher asked the angry student to ____ before explaining what happened.
questions.explain: calm down 意为“冷静下来”，符合老师劝学生先冷静再解释的语境。

questions.stem: What does the phrase "hand out" mean?
questions.explain: hand out 意为“分发”，如老师把试卷发给学生。

questions.stem: Please ____ your name and phone number at the top of the form.
questions.explain: fill in 意为“填写（表格、信息）”，与 form 搭配最合适。

questions.stem: In the sentence "A strange question came up during the interview", what does "come up" mean?
questions.explain: 这里 come up 指“（问题、话题）出现、被提出”。

questions.stem: We had to ____ home because I forgot my keys.
questions.explain: go back 意为“返回、回去”，符合忘带钥匙要回家的语境。

questions.stem: What does the phrase "bring back" mean?
questions.explain: bring back 常指“使回想起（回忆）”，也可指“把某物带回来”。

questions.stem: Even though it started to rain, the players decided to ____ playing.
questions.explain: carry on doing 意为“继续做某事”，符合下雨仍继续比赛的语境。

questions.stem: What does the phrase "cut down on" mean?
questions.explain: cut down on 后接名词，意为“减少（吸烟、糖等的摄入或使用）”。

questions.stem: Make sure you don't ____ any important details when you tell the story.
questions.explain: leave out 意为“遗漏、不包括”，提醒不要漏掉重要细节。

questions.stem: What does the phrase "turn out" mean?
questions.explain: turn out (to be) 意为“结果是、原来是”，表示事情最终的发展情况。

questions.stem: The cinema was too dark, so Ben ____ his phone and used it as a light.
questions.explain: took out 意为"拿出"，符合黑暗中拿出手机当灯用的语境。

questions.stem: What does the phrasal verb "come in" mean?
questions.explain: come in 既可表示"进来"，也可表示某款式、时尚"开始流行"。

questions.stem: All the lights ____ suddenly when the storm hit the small town.
questions.explain: go out 可表示灯、火等"熄灭"，与暴风雨中灯灭的语境相符。

questions.stem: What does the phrasal verb "put down" mean?
questions.explain: put down 意为"放下"或"写下、记下"，是常考义项。

questions.stem: The whole family went to the airport to ____ Grandma before her long flight.
questions.explain: see off 意为"为某人送行"，去机场送奶奶正合语境。

questions.stem: What does the phrasal verb "think over" mean?
questions.explain: think over 意为"仔细考虑"，指认真思考后再做决定。

questions.stem: The kids kept asking to go to the zoo, and in the end their father ____ and agreed.
questions.explain: gave in 意为"让步、屈服"，指父亲经不住请求最终同意。

questions.stem: What does the phrasal verb "show up" mean?
questions.explain: show up 意为"出席、露面"，指人出现在某场合。

questions.stem: Lily's creative design helped her ____ among all the competitors in the contest.
questions.explain: stand out 意为"突出、与众不同"，与 among all the competitors 搭配表示在参赛者中脱颖而出。

questions.stem: What does the phrasal verb "get through" mean?
questions.explain: get through 可表示"完成、通过"，打电话语境中指"接通"。
